sources: Frozen per-view RGB and semantic overlay alignment panels;20 training panels and6 individual test panels
observations: No camera support is visibly retained in the nadir areas of the reviewed panels.
Nadir fill is floor-colored and the fixed labels assign it to building.
Semantic layout and ERP orientation agree at inspection resolution; no new rotation or crop was introduced.
Official CAD projection boundaries retain small local mismatches and low-resolution thin objects are difficult; this audit does not assert pixel-perfect human ground truth.
